spGetCharacterEquipment
Procedure.Body:
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT ce.characterId, ce.slotType, ce.equipmentInstanceId, ei.itemId, ei.enhancementLevel FROM [dbo].[CharacterEquipment] ce INNER JOIN [dbo].[EquipmentInstance] ei ON ce.equipmentInstanceId = ei.equipmentInstanceId WHERE ce.characterId = @characterId ORDER BY ce.slotType;

Procedure.name: spUpsertCharacterEquipment
Procedure.Body:
SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
MERGE [dbo].[CharacterEquipment] AS target USING (SELECT @characterId, @slotType, @equipmentInstanceId) AS source(characterId, slotType, equipmentInstanceId) ON target.characterId = source.characterId AND target.slotType = source.slotType WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET equipmentInstanceId = source.equipmentInstanceId WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (characterId, slotType, equipmentInstanceId) VALUES (source.characterId, source.slotType, source.equipmentInstanceId);

Procedure.Body: INSERT INTO [dbo].[Gold] ([gold], [name], [createDate]) VALUES(@gold, @name, @createDate)

Procedure.name: spGetGold
Procedure.Body: SELECT id, gold, name, createDate FROM [dbo].[Gold] where gold = (@gold)

Procedure.name: spGetCharacterInventory
Procedure.Body:
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT slotIndex, itemId, count, isQuickslot, equipmentInstanceId FROM [dbo].[CharacterInventory] WHERE characterId = @characterId ORDER BY slotIndex;

Procedure.name: spSaveInventorySlot
Procedure.Body:
SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
MERGE [dbo].[CharacterInventory] AS target USING (SELECT @characterId, @slotIndex, @itemId, @count, @isQuickslot, @equipmentInstanceId) AS source(characterId, slotIndex, itemId, count, isQuickslot, equipmentInstanceId) ON target.characterId = source.characterId AND target.slotIndex = source.slotIndex WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET itemId = source.itemId, count = source.count, isQuickslot = source.isQuickslot, equipmentInstanceId = source.equipmentInstanceId WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (characterId, slotIndex, itemId, count, isQuickslot, equipmentInstanceId) VALUES (source.characterId, source.slotIndex, source.itemId, source.count, source.isQuickslot, source.equipmentInstanceId);
